claims.text: This repo forecasts stock market volatility one, five, and twenty two days ahead with machine learning, signal discovery in its own words: HAR baselines are progressively enriched until the QLIKE improvement is statistically significant and the IV-RV gap it implies is tradeable.

claims.text: Quality is decided by competition: every vol run is a tournament, 13 models compared with statistical tests in the full configuration, ranked on QLIKE, an asymmetric loss that punishes underestimating volatility, and only statistically significant wins over HAR count.

claims.text: What it is not: a live trading system, nothing listens on a socket, every entry point is a batch command that runs to completion, and the closest thing to an order it ever emits is a printed LONG, SHORT, or FLAT signal.
